attrs.why_open: A mediated world records WHY each support edge exists; a package manager records only that a dependency is declared. That extra information is exactly what an affectedness predicate needs, so a closed world could in principle DECIDE affectedness where the SBOM ecosystem has to author VEX statements by hand. Nothing here establishes that it can, and nothing establishes that it cannot. The doubt is recorded because R7 already made the mirror-image mistake once — importing an open-ecosystem limitation as an inherent property.
